correctness.rationale: Exhaustive bijection from rooted Euler circuits on binary four-bit overlap graph to all 2048 cyclic order-five de Bruijn rotation classes; all 32 by 32 circular windows tested for literal reversal equality. Independent 65536-order Hierholzer enumeration gives the exact same 2048 classes; center-expansion agrees with reversal test on every word; complete table-by-table equality checked. The 23 joint frequencies sum to 2048, sharp range P=22..30 excluding 25,26, longest L at most 15. This is finite exhaustive certification, not an infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The full-text 2006 primary palindrome/de Bruijn discussion concerns general formation of palindromes, not the exact order-five joint histogram. The available 2014 circular-word result and OEIS unrestricted maximum concern broader domains but do not imply the conditional complete frequency distribution. Actual semantic searches produced no published matching classification. A pertinent 2014 full text was inaccessible, so historical priority is not guaranteed.

value.rationale: A complete joint and lengthwise palindromic-complexity classification on all 2048 binary order-five de Bruijn necklaces fills a natural gap between unrestricted circular-word bounds and de Bruijn uniqueness. The spectrum has nontrivial missing values, 23 distinct joint states, 51 lengthwise states and a sharp length-15 cutoff, supporting meaningful word-combinatorial comparisons.
